test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 1 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Some statements about food chain and energy flow through an ecosystem are given below. Select the INCORRECT statement.

options.text: Food webs include two or more food chains.
The lower the trophic level at which an organism feeds, the less energy it has.
All organisms that are not producers are consumers.
A single organism can feed at several trophic levels.

solution:
The correct answer is __**The lower the trophic level at which an organism feeds, the less energy it has.**__

• **Food webs** include two or more food chains.
 
• The lower the trophic level at which an organism feeds, the **more energy** it has, not less.
